import hashlib, json, os, platform, random, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'scripts'),str(ROOT/'bench')]
from benchmark_samples import HostGate, summarize_samples, GATE_METHOD
from zx_compare import oracle
work=ROOT/'build/benchmarks/native-opt'
variants=sys.argv[1].split(',')
mode=sys.argv[2]
trials=int(sys.argv[3])
out=work/sys.argv[4]
assert platform.node()=='alpha'
virt=subprocess.run(['systemd-detect-virt'],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert virt.stdout.strip()=='none' and virt.returncode==1
assert Path('/etc/machine-id').read_text().strip()=='56391af3c57a496aba7e9f1f24cce732'
env=dict(os.environ,ZIRAN_LEARN='off',ZIRAN_NATIVE_CACHE='off',HARMONY_DESKTOP_RECOVERY='0')
for name in ['DISPLAY','WAYLAND_DISPLAY','XAUTHORITY','DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS','SESSION_MANAGER']: env.pop(name,None)
def invoke(argv):
    run=subprocess.run(list(map(str,argv)),capture_output=True,text=True,env=HostGate.environment(env))
    if run.returncode: raise RuntimeError(run.stdout[-2000:]+run.stderr[-2000:])
    return json.loads(run.stdout.strip())
def digest(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path,'rb') as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(65536),b''): h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()
receipt={'started_utc':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),'host':platform.node(),'platform':platform.platform(),'virtualization':'none','machine_id':Path('/etc/machine-id').read_text().strip(),'cpu':next(x.split(':',1)[1].strip() for x in Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith('model name')),'learning':'off','cache':'off','method':GATE_METHOD,'mode':mode,'trials':trials,'artifacts':{},'samples':[],'complete':False}
for label in variants:
    for name in ['libziran.a','standard-host','zx-host']:
        path=work/label/name
        receipt['artifacts'][str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=digest(path)
for name in ['suite.zx','fixture.zx']:
    receipt['artifacts'][str((work/name).relative_to(ROOT))]=digest(work/name)
def save(): out.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
gate=HostGate()
receipt['gate']=gate.describe()
rng=random.Random(20261127)
if mode=='records': cases=[('integer',0,100000),('record',1,100000)]
else:
    old=json.loads((work/'standard-screen.json').read_text())
    cases=[(w['name'],i,w['size']) for i,w in enumerate(old['workloads']) if mode=='all' or w['name'] in mode.split(',')]
    expected={w['name']:w['result'] for w in old['workloads']}
for trial in range(trials):
    jobs=[(label,case) for case in cases for label in variants]
    rng.shuffle(jobs)
    for label,(name,kind,size) in jobs:
        gate.choose_core()
        if mode=='records':
            seed=123456+trial*100
            batches=128
            want=sum(oracle(seed+j,size,kind) for j in range(batches))
            def job():
                row=invoke([work/label/'zx-host','native',work/'fixture.zx',seed,size,kind,batches,want])
                assert row['checksum']==want and row['native_ok'] and row['backend']=='NativeX86_64',row
                row['per_entry_ms']=row['warm_ms']/batches
                return row
        else:
            def job():
                row=invoke([work/label/'standard-host',work/'suite.zx',kind,size,11,expected[name]])
                assert row['result']==expected[name]
                row['inner_summary']=summarize_samples(row['batch_samples_ms'])
                row['per_entry_ms']=row['inner_summary']['median_ms']
                return row
        row=gate.measure(job)
        row.update(variant=label,trial=trial,name=name,kind=kind,size=size)
        receipt['samples'].append(row)
        save()
        print(trial,label,name,round(row['per_entry_ms'],6),flush=True)
receipt['summary']=[]
for name,kind,size in cases:
    for label in variants:
        raw=[r['per_entry_ms'] for r in receipt['samples'] if r['name']==name and r['variant']==label]
        receipt['summary'].append(dict(name=name,variant=label,raw_samples_ms=raw,**summarize_samples(raw)))
receipt['complete']=True
receipt['finished_utc']=time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime())
save()
print('COMPLETE',out,flush=True)
